messages:
maria: quick question — the provisioning doc example for Dedicated mentions 'isolation labels' but the SDK snippet we copy-pasted in python is out-of-date. can someone confirm precedence rules for tenant labels vs. reserved-pool labels?

samir: short answer: reserved-pool labels win at allocation time; tenant labels are merged and used for policy evaluation later. we should make that explicit in the example.

elaine: thanks — can you paste the exact python snippet you used? i can patch it in the PR.

maria: pasted below. this is what landed in the handbook currently: ```py
client.create_reserved_capacity(
    tenant_id="acct-123",
    labels={"env": "prod", "priority": "standard"},
    reserved_pool="gpu-pool-1",
)
```

samir: that's old — new SDK surfaces label precedence with an explicit field `binding_labels` for the pool and `tenant_labels` for the request. correct snippet should be: ```py
client.create_reserved_capacity(
    tenant_id="acct-123",
    tenant_labels={"env": "prod", "priority": "standard"},
    binding_labels={"env": "prod", "reserved_tier": "gold"},
    reserved_pool="gpu-pool-1",
)
```

kevin: fyi the docs anchor `#isolation-labels` is broken (404) — i tried linking to it from the autoscale guide. someone moved the section during the restructure.

maria: oh no. i'll add a small 'label precedence' subsection and a one-line note under autoscale that links to it. can we also add a tiny cheatsheet table showing sample label combos and expected behavior?

elaine: yes please. table can be 3 rows: (tenant only) -> no preemption, (pool binding + tenant) -> pool binding wins, (conflicting reserved_tier) -> explicit policy required. keep it tiny for mobile readability.

samir: small nit: we should include the surge-fallback example too — i ran into a customer case where preemption interacts with fallback routing and it confused their on-call. propose adding a snippet showing fallback to a cheaper model when pool is saturated. e.g.: ```yaml
request_routing:
  - when: pool_unavailable
    to: model:llama-7b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: true
```

maria: great. can someone open a docs PR with the label precedence subsection, updated python + go SDK snippets, the tiny table, the YAML routing example, and the anchor fix? i'm short today.

elaine: i'll take the PR. i'm free after 2pm PT. i'll also add a short integration test that renders the markdown and validates the anchor target exists.

kevin: tagging infra: @dev-docs-bot — can you run a quick link-check on the branch when it's up? :mag:  
dev-docs-bot: link-check queued for branch/patch/provisioning-labels-175820. report will be posted in this thread.

maria: thanks all. timeline: PR by EOD, review in morning. if anyone sees regression in examples, ping me. :thumbsup: 

dev-docs-bot: link-check complete — 1 broken anchor fixed, no other 4xx links. full report: https://ci.internal/reports/175820-linkcheck (internal)

samir: i'll follow up with a short note to the SDK team to add the `binding_labels` param to the public reference (we added it last quarter but docs missed it).

elaine: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4287 — includes snippets, table, anchor fix. PTAL.

kevin: reviewed and left two tiny wording nits. approved after those.

maria: merged. thanks team. i'll put a quick blurb in the release notes about the clarification and the new snippet.

samir: closing loop with support — filed KB update for tenants about label precedence. ticket 9876.

maria: awesome. thread archived once release notes published.
